verdict.rationale: Folk's pricing page lists "Dashboards" as a feature of its higher tier and "Pipeline management" in the base tier, so it has some first-party in-app reporting. Nothing in the pack describes what those dashboards cover or how reports are built. The API and webhooks are developer building blocks for external reporting, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of report and dashboard building, coverage of pipeline, activity and conversion metrics, any detail on customization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
